title: First working day and insurance start date
purpose: The employee enters and thereby confirms the first working day. Lonio derives the pension fund insurance start date from it, always from the latest date.

stories.title: Employee enters the first working day
stories.i_want: every new employee to enter their first working day in the onboarding questionnaire, which also confirms it
stories.so_that: the pension fund registration and the onboarding are based on the date the employee actually starts. That date often moves, for example when the employee agrees an earlier exit with the old employer.
stories.priority_reason: HR calls the first working day 'the number one thing' for the pension fund. A first working day that was not updated caused a wrong insurance start date at the fund and weeks of fixing (Julia incident).

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day is always asked and required
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee fills in the onboarding questionnaire, whatever their home address, nationality or civil status
acceptance_criteria.when: they reach the 'Start of employment' step (after the home address)
acceptance_criteria.then: Lonio asks for their first working day at Muster AG. The employee cannot submit the questionnaire without it.

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day is a calendar date
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee is asked for their first working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the answer is one calendar date, shown as DD.MM.YYYY (e.g. 15.03.2026)

acceptance_criteria.title: The employee's entry counts as the confirmed date
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has entered a first working day and changes it before submitting, for example because they agreed an earlier exit with their old employer
acceptance_criteria.then: Lonio records the last date the employee entered as the confirmed first working day, for the pension fund (as the basis of the insurance start date) and for HR. No earlier date is kept.

acceptance_criteria.title: Only HR changes the date after submission
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.when: their first working day moves afterwards
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee can no longer change it in the questionnaire, which is now read-only. Only HR can change the date; that HR-side change is specified in the later HR spec. The latest date always counts, and no history of earlier dates is kept.

stories.title: Insurance start date derived from the first working day
stories.i_want: the insurance start date to be derived from the employee's latest first working day, without asking the employee for it
stories.so_that: the employee is registered with the right insurance start date (always the 1st of a month), even when the first working day moves
stories.priority_reason: A wrong insurance start date at the fund caused an unfriendly letter and weeks of fixing (Julia incident). 'Insurance start date' is a required field of the registration.

acceptance_criteria.title: Insurance start date is not asked
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee fills in the onboarding questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: Lonio does not ask the employee for an insurance start date. It derives the date from the first working day and records it for the pension fund's required 'Insurance start date' field.

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day on the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee's first working day is the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: Lonio derives the insurance start date
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance starts on the first working day itself

examples.name: Start on the 1st of a month

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day on any other day
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee's first working day is not the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: Lonio derives the insurance start date
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance starts on the 1st of the following month, also across the turn of the year

examples.name: Julia (hr_transcript/F-hr_transcript-d7a23b), first working day 15 March (year illustrative)
Start on the last day of a month

acceptance_criteria.title: Always derived from the latest first working day
acceptance_criteria.given: the first working day has changed, either by the employee before submission or by HR after submission
acceptance_criteria.when: Lonio derives the insurance start date
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date is derived again from the latest first working day. A date derived from an earlier first working day is never kept as the insurance start date.
